title: DelegationCredential wire form
$comment: Structural residue of the delegation.* rules. The Owner-binding relation (issuer is an Owner DID; the subject's Owner equals the issuer; delegatedBy equals issuer) is cross-field/structural and not expressible here — delegation.binding and its vectors pin it. additionalProperties stays true (round-trip fidelity).

issuer.$comment: delegation.binding: an Owner DID (the structural Owner relation is vector-pinned, not schema-checkable).

validFrom.$comment: delegation.shape requires validFrom; same form as pipeline-pass-credential.json validFrom (see its $comment).

id.$comment: The delegated Pipeline or Process DID.

delegatedBy.$comment: Restates the issuer for subject-local checking; equality with issuer is behavioral (delegation.shape).

scope.$comment: delegation.scope: non-empty byte-explicit tokens. The literal "*" is the universal wildcard reading the rule prohibits (delegation-005); profile token vocabularies may prohibit more.

verificationMethod.$comment: delegation.proof: names the issuer DID — the DID-equality check is behavioral.

proofPurpose.$comment: delegation.proof pins the purpose for delegation credentials.
